vision: Anatomy Nexus: a comprehensive, visual, interconnected human-body knowledge platform. Anatomy is the foundation; every other section connects back to it so a reader can move from body part → structure → function → symptoms → conditions → tests → procedures → treatment → learning.

entities.name: AnatomicalStructure
entities.where: data/hd/atlas.json → structures; descriptions in data/content/atlas-content.json → structures
entities.note: 1,671 named structures over 2,234 mesh pieces; FMA concept id, system, side, pair, parents, region tags, organ membership.

entities.name: BodySystem
entities.note: 16 systems with overview, functions, clinical notes, related systems, key structures; the reproductive system covers female, male and gender-affirming anatomy.

entities.name: Organ
entities.note: 47 organs and skeletal groups: 40 resolved to atlas structures by rule, and 7 (uterus and cervix, ovaries and fallopian tubes, vagina, vulva and clitoris, breasts, neovagina, neophallus) that the adult male reference body does not model, published as full written anatomy pages that show the modelled structures around them; aliases for search.

entities.name: Region
entities.note: 7 spatial regions computed from bounding boxes.

entities.name: MedicalTerm
entities.note: 156 terms in 8 categories (directions, planes, movements, regions, structures, word parts, disease processes, clinical terms) with atlas links and pronunciation.

entities.name: Quiz / Flashcard
entities.where: generated at runtime from structures and terms
entities.note: Identify-the-structure, locate-the-structure and flashcards in 3D; terminology, condition, test and medication quizzes; viva questions from physiology key facts.

entities.name: PhysiologyTopic
entities.note: 35 entries. Links: explains → BodySystem / Organ / AnatomicalStructure.

entities.name: Symptom
entities.note: 22 entries. Links: involves → AnatomicalStructure / Organ; suggests → Condition; evaluatedBy → MedicalTest.

entities.name: Condition
entities.note: 50 entries. Links: affects → Organ / BodySystem; causes → Symptom; diagnosedBy → MedicalTest / ImagingStudy; treatedBy → Procedure / Medication.

entities.name: MedicalTest
entities.note: 32 entries. Links: measures → BodySystem; relatedTo → Condition. v1.2: 16 tests at full depth with components linked to biomarkers, a reference-range policy, guideline thresholds with jurisdiction and source, factors and what the test cannot tell.

entities.name: ImagingStudy
entities.note: 7 entries. Links: shows → Region / Organ; usedFor → Condition.

entities.name: Procedure
entities.note: 19 entries. Links: operatesOn → Organ / AnatomicalStructure; treats → Condition.

entities.name: Medication
entities.note: 30 entries. Links: targets → Organ / BodySystem; treats → Condition. v1.2: 12 medicines at full depth (brands and prescription status by region, uses by licence status, pathway, targets, sourced warnings, contraindications, interactions, monitoring, special populations, pharmacokinetics).

entities.name: FirstAidTopic / HealthTopic
entities.note: 16 + 9 entries. Links: concerns → Organ / BodySystem.

entities.name: Biomarker
entities.note: 33 analytes measured by the tests: what each is, which organ makes or clears it, why higher or lower, what distorts it; linked from every test component and from the medicines that change it.

entities.name: BiologicalTarget
entities.note: 24 receptors, enzymes, ion channels, transporters and pathways with the medicines and classes that act on them: the bridge from a medicine to the anatomy it changes.

entities.name: DrugInteraction
entities.note: 69 sourced pair records (drug–drug, drug–class, therapeutic duplication) with mechanism, effect, official wording, management, monitoring and a severity state assigned only where the cited wording supports it.

entities.name: MedicationProduct
entities.note: 14 brand and combination products mapped to their active ingredients so a brand resolves to its generic page and a combination is checked ingredient by ingredient.

entities.name: Comparison
entities.note: 7 structured comparisons (CRP vs ESR, creatinine vs eGFR, ECG vs echocardiogram, CT vs MRI, TSH vs free T4, HbA1c vs glucose, atorvastatin vs rosuvastatin) drawn from the entity pages' own properties.

entities.name: KnowledgeGraph
entities.note: 5,688 validated typed links between 303 topics, 47 organs, 15 systems, 212 structures and 156 terms; every reverse link is precomputed so any page can show what points at it.

phases.name: Phase 1 · Foundation
phases.summary: Human anatomy and the data structure everything else connects to.

items.name: Entity data model: structures, systems, organs, regions, terms
Women's anatomy (uterus, ovaries, vagina, vulva, breasts, pelvic floor) and the anatomy of gender-affirming surgery (neovagina, neophallus)
Deep links and embeds for every structure, organ, region and system

phases.name: Phase 2 · High-value educational layer
phases.summary: Natural extensions of the anatomy content.

phases.name: Phase 3 · Medical knowledge
phases.summary: From anatomy into real-world medical knowledge.

items.name: Women's health: menstrual cycle, pregnancy, menopause, endometriosis, PCOS, fibroids, breast, cervical and ovarian cancer, prolapse, incontinence, cervical screening

phases.name: Phase 4 · Clinical understanding
phases.summary: Procedures, medications and clinical terminology. Advanced pathology primers remain planned.

items.name: Gender-affirming care: hormone therapy physiology, vaginoplasty, phalloplasty and metoidioplasty, chest masculinisation, estradiol and testosterone

phases.name: Phase 5 · Public health & practical knowledge
phases.summary: First aid, emergencies, prevention and lifestyle.

items.name: Health & prevention: exercise, sleep, nutrition, smoking, alcohol, hydration

phases.name: Phase 6 · Advanced interactive platform
phases.summary: Knowledge graph, personalised learning, image-based learning and clinical cases.

items.name: Clinical layer: structured tests, medicines, interactions and comparisons

sections.name: Physiology
sections.summary: Anatomy explains what is there; physiology explains what it does. Cardiovascular, respiratory, nervous, digestive, renal and endocrine physiology topics will attach to the system and organ pages.

sections.name: Learn
sections.summary: Histology, pathology, embryology and clinical terminology primers.

sections.name: Symptoms explorer
sections.summary: Start from what a person experiences (headache, chest pain, knee pain…). Each page: what it is, relevant anatomy, common and less common causes, associated symptoms, when to seek urgent care, related conditions, tests and anatomy. The site educates; it does not diagnose.

sections.name: Diseases & conditions
sections.summary: Structured condition pages: definition, affected body part and system, causes, risk factors, symptoms, complications, diagnosis, imaging, treatment, procedures, prevention and references, all linked to anatomy.

sections.name: Medical tests
sections.summary: Blood, urine, heart, lung and other tests: what they measure, how they are done, what results generally indicate, and which anatomy they relate to.

sections.name: Medical imaging
sections.summary: X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, PET, mammography and fluoroscopy: how each works, what it shows, how normal anatomy appears and common abnormalities.

sections.name: Medical procedures
sections.summary: Appendectomy, knee replacement, angioplasty, endoscopy and more, explained step by step with the anatomy involved.

sections.name: Medications
sections.summary: Educational medication pages: class, mechanism, target organ or system, side effects, warnings and related conditions.

sections.name: First aid & emergency knowledge
sections.summary: CPR, choking, bleeding, burns, fractures, fainting, seizures and more, aligned with authoritative guidance.

sections.name: Health & prevention
sections.summary: How exercise, sleep, nutrition, smoking, alcohol and hydration act on the organs and systems described in the atlas.

sections.name: Student learning platform
sections.summary: Flashcards, quizzes, anatomy identification, labeling exercises, viva practice and exam modes for medicine, nursing, physiotherapy, dentistry and allied health.

sections.name: Knowledge graph
sections.summary: Every entity carries typed links so a reader can keep exploring: Heart → cardiovascular system → cardiac physiology → coronary arteries → ECG → heart failure → angioplasty → medications → symptoms → tests.

sections.name: Clinical layer
sections.summary: Tests, biomarkers, medicines, drug targets, interactions and comparisons as structured, source-backed, region-aware entities: every warning, contraindication, indication, threshold and interaction cites the official document and country it came from, and every page shows its review status.

items.name: Independent clinical review of the clinical layer

sections.name: What comes next
sections.summary: Histology, embryology and pathology primers; more conditions, tests and medications on the same schema; image-based learning (labelled radiographs and slides); clinical case studies; progress tracking and personalised revision; a female reference body when an open dataset allows.
